did: I took ollama off home, as you asked: its compose file, its release entry, its scrape entry, its dashboard lines, its docs and its nix model manager are gone, and the caps check no longer counts it, so home's caps now total 22.38 GiB. I finished writing home's six compute invariants now that the contention guard has landed. I also made the Renders page notice a render worker that dies mid-render: it stops showing the job as rendering within a minute, rather than after hours. Each pull request had an independent review, and every finding was fixed or answered on it.

calls.title: The ollama path still in home's encrypted settings
options: let envctl accept that one name until you remove it, with a test that fails once you have
hold the pull request until you edit the encrypted file
calls.why: Only your key can rewrite that file, and a hand edit breaks its seal; the test means the exception cannot outlive your edit (C210).
calls.undo: Remove OLLAMA_MODELS_PATH from RETIRED in apps/envctl/src/conform.rs, together with your sops edit.

calls.title: What counts as a render worker's sign of life
options: the worker's own loop stamps it every 10 seconds
a time on every line the recorder prints
calls.why: A scene or the assembly can print nothing for minutes, so only the worker's own loop gives a tight bound without false alarms (C211).
